slides.title: The way to the park
slides.text: Rosa wants to go to the central park. Tariq tells her: go along the main road, turn right at the traffic light, cross the bridge, go past the bank and take the second exit at the roundabout. The park is on the left. Rosa repeats everything and arrives in ten minutes.
slides.pt: Rosa segue as direções detalhadas de Tariq e chega ao parque.
